deployment_authority_events_transition_c.name: deployment_authority_events_transition_check
deployment_authority_events_transition_c.value:
(
        "deployment_authority_events"."event_type" = 'ledger_activation'
        AND "deployment_authority_events"."old_ledger_activated" IS FALSE
        AND "deployment_authority_events"."new_ledger_activated" IS TRUE
        AND "deployment_authority_events"."old_enforced_minimum_client_build" = "deployment_authority_events"."new_enforced_minimum_client_build"
      ) OR (
        "deployment_authority_events"."event_type" = 'minimum_client_build'
        AND "deployment_authority_events"."old_ledger_activated" = "deployment_authority_events"."new_ledger_activated"
        AND "deployment_authority_events"."old_contract_version" = "deployment_authority_events"."new_contract_version"
      )

entity_mutation_receipts_revision_check.name: entity_mutation_receipts_revision_check
entity_mutation_receipts_revision_check.value:
"entity_mutation_receipts"."result_revision" > 0 AND (
        ("entity_mutation_receipts"."operation" = 'create' AND "entity_mutation_receipts"."base_revision" IS NULL AND "entity_mutation_receipts"."result_revision" = 1)
        OR ("entity_mutation_receipts"."operation" IN ('update', 'delete') AND "entity_mutation_receipts"."base_revision" > 0
          AND "entity_mutation_receipts"."result_revision" = "entity_mutation_receipts"."base_revision" + 1)
      )

legacy_medication_history_source_shape_c.name: legacy_medication_history_source_shape_check
legacy_medication_history_source_shape_c.value:
("legacy_medication_history"."legacy_source_kind" = 'dose_log' AND "legacy_medication_history"."state" IN ('taken', 'missed', 'skipped'))
    OR ("legacy_medication_history"."legacy_source_kind" = 'pill_stock' AND "legacy_medication_history"."state" IS NULL AND "legacy_medication_history"."schedule_id" IS NULL)

legacy_medication_history_inventory_evid.name: legacy_medication_history_inventory_evidence_check
legacy_medication_history_inventory_evid.value:
("legacy_medication_history"."historical_inventory_delta_evidence" IS NULL AND "legacy_medication_history"."inventory_delta_provenance" = 'unknown' AND "legacy_medication_history"."inventory_disposition" = 'effect_unknown')
    OR ("legacy_medication_history"."historical_inventory_delta_evidence" IS NOT NULL AND "legacy_medication_history"."inventory_delta_provenance" IN ('explicit_source', 'linked_command') AND "legacy_medication_history"."inventory_disposition" = 'evidence_only')

legacy_medication_history_coverage_check.name: legacy_medication_history_coverage_check
legacy_medication_history_coverage_check.value:
"legacy_medication_history"."coverage_state" IN ('pending', 'covered', 'blocked')
    AND ("legacy_medication_history"."coverage_state" <> 'covered' OR
      ("legacy_medication_history"."sync_change_id" IS NOT NULL AND "legacy_medication_history"."mapped_entity_type" = 'legacy_medication_history'
        AND "legacy_medication_history"."mapped_entity_id" = "legacy_medication_history"."history_id" AND "legacy_medication_history"."mapped_at" IS NOT NULL))

medication_handoff_journal_evidence_chec.name: medication_handoff_journal_evidence_check
medication_handoff_journal_evidence_chec.value:
("medication_handoff_journal"."before_evidence" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("medication_handoff_journal"."before_evidence") = 'object' AND octet_length("medication_handoff_journal"."before_evidence"::text) <= 8192))
    AND ("medication_handoff_journal"."after_evidence" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("medication_handoff_journal"."after_evidence") = 'object' AND octet_length("medication_handoff_journal"."after_evidence"::text) <= 8192))
    AND ("medication_handoff_journal"."before_evidence" IS NOT NULL OR "medication_handoff_journal"."after_evidence" IS NOT NULL)

medication_handoff_journal_coverage_chec.name: medication_handoff_journal_coverage_check
medication_handoff_journal_coverage_chec.value:
"medication_handoff_journal"."coverage_state" IN ('pending', 'covered', 'blocked')
    AND ("medication_handoff_journal"."coverage_state" <> 'covered' OR
      ("medication_handoff_journal"."mapped_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        ("medication_handoff_journal"."history_entry_id" IS NOT NULL OR "medication_handoff_journal"."mapped_occurrence_id" IS NOT NULL
          OR "medication_handoff_journal"."mapped_occurrence_event_id" IS NOT NULL OR "medication_handoff_journal"."mapped_inventory_event_id" IS NOT NULL)))

medication_occurrences_source_shape_chec.name: medication_occurrences_source_shape_check
medication_occurrences_source_shape_chec.value:
("medication_occurrences"."source" = 'scheduled' AND "medication_occurrences"."schedule_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "medication_occurrences"."schedule_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "medication_occurrences"."planned_local_time" IS NOT NULL
      AND "medication_occurrences"."planned_at" IS NOT NULL AND "medication_occurrences"."expected" = true)
    OR ("medication_occurrences"."source" = 'prn' AND "medication_occurrences"."expected" = false)
    OR ("medication_occurrences"."source" = 'legacy' AND "medication_occurrences"."expected" = false)

medication_occurrences_supersession_chec.name: medication_occurrences_supersession_check
medication_occurrences_supersession_chec.value:
("medication_occurrences"."superseded_at" IS NULL AND "medication_occurrences"."superseded_by_occurrence_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("medication_occurrences"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND ("medication_occurrences"."superseded_by_occurrence_id" IS NULL
        OR "medication_occurrences"."superseded_by_occurrence_id" <> "medication_occurrences"."id"))

migration_issues_resolution_check.name: migration_issues_resolution_check
migration_issues_resolution_check.value:
("migration_issues"."state" = 'unresolved' AND "migration_issues"."revision" = 1
          AND "migration_issues"."resolved_by" IS NULL AND "migration_issues"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("migration_issues"."state" = 'resolved' AND "migration_issues"."revision" = 2
          AND "migration_issues"."resolved_by" = "migration_issues"."user_id" AND "migration_issues"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

occurrence_events_amount_check.name: occurrence_events_amount_check
occurrence_events_amount_check.value:
"occurrence_events"."administration_amount" IS NULL OR COALESCE((
      jsonb_typeof("occurrence_events"."administration_amount") = 'object'
      AND "occurrence_events"."administration_amount"->'version' = '1'::jsonb
      AND octet_length("occurrence_events"."administration_amount"::text) <= 512
      AND (
        "occurrence_events"."administration_amount" = '{"version": 1, "state": "unknown"}'::jsonb
        OR (
          "occurrence_events"."administration_amount"->>'state' = 'known'
          AND ("occurrence_events"."administration_amount" - ARRAY['version', 'state', 'quantity', 'unit']) = '{}'::jsonb
          AND jsonb_typeof("occurrence_events"."administration_amount"->'quantity') = 'string'
          AND length("occurrence_events"."administration_amount"->>'quantity') BETWEEN 1 AND 64
          AND jsonb_typeof("occurrence_events"."administration_amount"->'unit') = 'string'
          AND length("occurrence_events"."administration_amount"->>'unit') BETWEEN 1 AND 80
        )
      )
    ), FALSE)

occurrence_events_recorded_by_check.name: occurrence_events_recorded_by_check
occurrence_events_recorded_by_check.value:
"occurrence_events"."recorded_by" IS NULL OR COALESCE((
      "occurrence_events"."action" <> 'miss'
      AND jsonb_typeof("occurrence_events"."recorded_by") = 'object'
      AND "occurrence_events"."recorded_by"->'version' = '1'::jsonb
      AND ("occurrence_events"."recorded_by" - ARRAY['version', 'name']) = '{}'::jsonb
      AND "occurrence_events"."recorded_by" ? 'name'
      AND (
        jsonb_typeof("occurrence_events"."recorded_by"->'name') = 'null'
        OR (
          jsonb_typeof("occurrence_events"."recorded_by"->'name') = 'string'
          AND length("occurrence_events"."recorded_by"->>'name') BETWEEN 1 AND 100
          AND "occurrence_events"."recorded_by"->>'name' = btrim("occurrence_events"."recorded_by"->>'name')
        )
      )
    ), FALSE)

outbox_messages_payload_state_check.name: outbox_messages_payload_state_check
outbox_messages_payload_state_check.value:
("outbox_messages"."state" IN ('queued', 'sending', 'retrying') AND "outbox_messages"."encrypted_delivery_payload" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("outbox_messages"."state" IN ('sent', 'failedPermanent'))

pills_stock_unit_check.name: pills_stock_unit_check
pills_stock_unit_check.value: "pills"."stock_unit" IS NULL OR ("pills"."stock_unit" = btrim("pills"."stock_unit") AND length("pills"."stock_unit") BETWEEN 1 AND 80)

pills_prescriber_name_check.name: pills_prescriber_name_check
pills_prescriber_name_check.value: "pills"."prescriber_name" IS NULL OR length("pills"."prescriber_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

pills_pharmacy_name_check.name: pills_pharmacy_name_check
pills_pharmacy_name_check.value: "pills"."pharmacy_name" IS NULL OR length("pills"."pharmacy_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

pills_amount_per_use_check.name: pills_amount_per_use_check
pills_amount_per_use_check.value:
"pills"."amount_per_use" IS NULL OR COALESCE((
      jsonb_typeof("pills"."amount_per_use") = 'object'
      AND "pills"."amount_per_use"->'version' = '1'::jsonb
      AND octet_length("pills"."amount_per_use"::text) <= 512
      AND (
        "pills"."amount_per_use" = '{"version": 1, "state": "unknown"}'::jsonb
        OR (
          "pills"."amount_per_use"->>'state' = 'known'
          AND ("pills"."amount_per_use" - ARRAY['version', 'state', 'quantity', 'unit']) = '{}'::jsonb
          AND jsonb_typeof("pills"."amount_per_use"->'quantity') = 'string'
          AND length("pills"."amount_per_use"->>'quantity') BETWEEN 1 AND 64
          AND jsonb_typeof("pills"."amount_per_use"->'unit') = 'string'
          AND length("pills"."amount_per_use"->>'unit') BETWEEN 1 AND 80
        )
      )
    ), FALSE)

preactivation_medication_receipts_comple.name: preactivation_medication_receipts_completion_check
preactivation_medication_receipts_comple.value:
("preactivation_medication_receipts"."complete" = false AND "preactivation_medication_receipts"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "preactivation_medication_receipts"."result_metadata" IS NULL)
    OR ("preactivation_medication_receipts"."complete" = true AND "preactivation_medication_receipts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "preactivation_medication_receipts"."result_metadata" IS NOT NULL
      AND "preactivation_medication_receipts"."observed_subeffect_count" = "preactivation_medication_receipts"."expected_subeffect_count"
      AND "preactivation_medication_receipts"."reconciliation_disposition" IN ('applied', 'adopted', 'residual_applied', 'kept_server_state'))

preactivation_medication_receipts_target.name: preactivation_medication_receipts_target_check
preactivation_medication_receipts_target.value:
"preactivation_medication_receipts"."target_stock" IS NULL
    OR ("preactivation_medication_receipts"."observed_base_stock" IS NOT NULL AND "preactivation_medication_receipts"."inventory_delta" IS NOT NULL
      AND "preactivation_medication_receipts"."target_stock"::bigint = "preactivation_medication_receipts"."observed_base_stock"::bigint + "preactivation_medication_receipts"."inventory_delta"::bigint)

schedules_timezone_status_check.name: schedules_timezone_status_check
schedules_timezone_status_check.value:
("schedules"."time_zone_status" = 'known' AND "schedules"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("schedules"."time_zone_status" = 'legacy_unknown' AND "schedules"."time_zone" IS NULL)

schedules_legacy_quarantine_shape_check.name: schedules_legacy_quarantine_shape_check
schedules_legacy_quarantine_shape_check.value:
("schedules"."legacy_quarantine_issue_id" IS NULL
          AND "schedules"."legacy_quarantine_origin" IS NULL
          AND "schedules"."legacy_quarantine_source" IS NULL)
        OR ("schedules"."legacy_quarantine_issue_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "schedules"."legacy_quarantine_origin" = 'migration-0013'
          AND "schedules"."legacy_quarantine_source" IS NOT NULL
          AND jsonb_typeof("schedules"."legacy_quarantine_source") = 'object'
          AND octet_length("schedules"."legacy_quarantine_source"::text) <= 16384)

schedules_interval_shape_check.name: schedules_interval_shape_check
schedules_interval_shape_check.value:
("schedules"."frequency" = 'interval')
        = ("schedules"."every_days" IS NOT NULL AND "schedules"."anchor_date" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("schedules"."frequency" = 'interval'
          OR ("schedules"."every_days" IS NULL AND "schedules"."anchor_date" IS NULL))

schedules_window_order_check.name: schedules_window_order_check
schedules_window_order_check.value: "schedules"."start_date" IS NULL OR "schedules"."end_date" IS NULL OR "schedules"."end_date" >= "schedules"."start_date"

schedules_prn_no_window_check.name: schedules_prn_no_window_check
schedules_prn_no_window_check.value: "schedules"."frequency" <> 'prn' OR ("schedules"."start_date" IS NULL AND "schedules"."end_date" IS NULL)

schedules_frequency_days_check.name: schedules_frequency_days_check
schedules_frequency_days_check.value:
public.schedule_frequency_days_valid("schedules"."frequency", "schedules"."frequency_days")
        OR ("schedules"."legacy_quarantine_issue_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "schedules"."legacy_quarantine_origin" = 'migration-0013'
          AND "schedules"."legacy_quarantine_source" IS NOT NULL
          AND jsonb_typeof("schedules"."legacy_quarantine_source") = 'object'
          AND octet_length("schedules"."legacy_quarantine_source"::text) <= 16384
          AND "schedules"."is_active" = false)
